confirm_model.title: Confirm your model
confirm_model.description: Please check that your device is a Motorola Edge 50 Pro (XT2403, eqe). The Edge 50, Edge 50 Fusion, Edge 50 Neo and Edge 50 Ultra are different devices and are not supported.

unlock_phone.title: Unlock the bootloader
unlock_phone.description: Before installing Ubuntu Touch the bootloader must be unlocked. Enable OEM unlocking in the developer options, then request an unlock code from Motorola and apply it with 'fastboot oem unlock <code>'. This wipes all data on the device.

bootloader.title: Reboot to Bootloader
bootloader.description: With the device powered off, press and hold VOLUME DOWN + POWER until the bootloader screen appears.

recovery.title: Reboot to Recovery
recovery.description: With the device on the bootloader screen, use the volume buttons to select "Recovery mode" and press the power button to confirm.

options.name: Wipe Userdata
options.tooltip: Wipe personal data. *Required* if switching from something (e.g. Android) that isn't Ubuntu Touch.

options.name: Bootstrap
options.tooltip: Flash the boot chain using fastboot. Do NOT uncheck unless you know exactly what you're doing!
